text:
maya: Heads-up: we've detected a memory regression in embeddings service in eu-west1 starting ~23:10 UTC. error rate up ~4%, suspect kvcache churn under high-prefix reuse. proposing hotfix image + limited traffic shift to eu-west2 in tonight's 23:45-00:15 UTC change window.
deploy-bot: New deploy request DR-2026-453 created. image: registry.redwood/internal/embeddings:v3.2.1-hotfix. plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
duncan: prefer avoid full region cutover. can we do a gradual shift and keep old instances pinned for instant rollback? what's latency impact in eu-west2 tests?
selena: perf tests on eu-west2 show mem churn down ~30%, no latency regression. we'll pin previous image v3.2.0 for rollback.
maya: rollback criteria: immediate rollback to v3.2.0 if errors > 1% OR p95 latency increases >200ms sustained for 3 minutes. ops-bot: noted rollback thresholds.
duncan: need infra lead expedited approval. paging @rana for greenlight and recommended canary cadence.
selena: I approve from platform side. release note draft: "Embeddings: fix kvcache leak causing intermittent OOMs under high-prefix reuse. No model semantics change." https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DR-2026-453/notes
releasebot: Attached release note to DR-2026-453. Changelog: "v3.2.1-hotfix — kvcache memory stabilization"
duncan: Let's lock the window: start 23:45 UTC; 23:50 verify canary; 00:00 ramp; aim to finish by 00:10; monitoring hold until 00:25. all operators on deck.
maya: Ops runbook snippet: 
```
# start canary in eu-west2
deployctl rollout --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.1-hotfix --percent 5 --note "hotfix-DR-2026-453"
# rollback to pinned image
deployctl rollback --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.0
```
selena: Commands look good. i'll own telemetry/tracing during window.
duncan: ops-bot create temporary alerts for p95>200ms and errors>1% on embeddings-eu-west2. escalate to oncall -> infra-lead.
ops-bot: Temporary alert ALRT-7892 created. escalation chain set: oncall -> infra-lead.
maya: Rana, can you give expedited approval to start at 23:45? please confirm cadence (5m at 5%, 8m at 25%, then ramp)
rana: rana: approved. keep canary at 5% for 5m, 25% for 8m; only proceed to 100% if no regression. post release-note to #release-notes after cutoff.
duncan: ops-bot kick off at 23:45 UTC please.
ops-bot: Scheduled DR-2026-453 for 23:45 UTC. Operators: maya, selena, duncan.
duncan: post-deploy checklist: verify canary success, kv cache hit ratio, p95, error budget. i'll give final sign-off at 00:12 if metrics good.
maya: If any segfaults/OOMs, immediate rollback. otherwise proceed with ramp. :thumbsup: 
selena: posting release note to #release-notes now.
releasebot: Posted: "Embeddings v3.2.1-hotfix — kvcache stabilization" https://console.redwood/releases/DR-2026-453
duncan: all set. thanks everyone.
maya: closing thread; will update with final status after hold window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
